reason: My team works in a spreadsheet and it costs me nothing. A new CRM with no customer references, and I would be paying monthly out of a $13,000 year, is a hard sell when amoCRM and Bitrix24 have trials too.
objection: No one I know uses it and there are no references, so I do not know if my data and my team's time will be wasted. Moving everything over and getting my staff to change habits still sounds like weeks of trouble, even if you do the move.
would_change_my_mind: Names of two or three companies like mine in Uzbekistan that use it, and a cheaper plan at around 15 dollars that I could test with my own clients.
